lines.text: Why can't I rip a zipper apart... but this tiny thing opens it in one second?
Because you're pulling wrong.
I pull GREAT.
Look closer. Two rows of teeth, staggered, like fingers lacing together.
Each tooth has a bump on top and a dent underneath.
And the slider has a Y-shaped tunnel inside.
Zip up, and the Y squeezes both rows together, one tooth from each side...
and every bump drops into the next dent. Locked.
So pulling it sideways...
Does nothing. The teeth are hooked into each other.
And zipping down?
The Y splits them apart. One tooth at a time.
Then why does my jacket zipper keep splitting open?
Worn slider. It's not squeezing hard enough anymore.
Grab pliers and pinch it a hair tighter. Gently.
Gently. Got it.
You're gonna crush it, aren't you.
Absolutely.
And now you know.
Cool. But real question...
